parameters.name: DnStorageSpace
parameters.description: The disk space size of the storage node.

parameters.name: EngineVersion
parameters.description: The MySQL engine version. Valid values: 5.7 and 8.0.

parameters.name: ExtraParams
parameters.description: Additional parameters.

parameters.name: IsColumnarReadDBInstance
parameters.description: Specifies whether the instance to be created is a columnar read-only instance.

parameters.name: IsReadDBInstance
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the instance is a read-only instance.

- **true**: Yes
- **false**: No

parameters.name: NetworkType
parameters.description: The network type. Only VPC is supported.

parameters.name: OriginMinorVersion
parameters.description: The minor version number. This parameter is generally not required.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the instance.

- **PREPAY**: Subscription
- **POSTPAY**: Pay-as-you-go

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The billing cycle. For subscription instances, valid values are Year and Month. For pay-as-you-go instances, the default value is Hour.

parameters.name: PrimaryDBInstanceName
parameters.description: The primary instance must be specified if the instance is a read-only instance.

parameters.name: PrimaryZone
parameters.description: The primary availability zone.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the instance resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This parameter can be left empty. This feature is currently not supported.

parameters.name: SecondaryZone
parameters.description: The secondary availability zone.

parameters.name: Series
parameters.description:
Enterprise Edition: enterprise
Standard Edition: standard

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type.
* Local disk: custom_local_ssd
* Cloud disk: cloud_auto

parameters.name: TertiaryZone
parameters.description: The tertiary availability zone.

parameters.name: TopologyType
parameters.description:
The topology type:

- **3azones**: Three availability zones
- **1azone**: Single availability zone

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description:
The subscription duration. You can specify the number of months or years for prepaid instances.

> When Period is set to Year, valid values for this parameter are 1, 2, and 3.

parameters.name: VPCId
parameters.description: The VPC ID.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description: The vSwitch ID.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The availability zone of the instance.
